page.notes: The first block is in black letter (German), set at the top as the continuation of the previous page's text. The "Synopsis" line mixes roman and black letter; the black letter phrase is marked. "schirmtach" and "Städte" were read from a small, slightly faded scan; "schirmtach" may be a printing variant and should be checked against a larger image. The heading "DE HISTORIA." is a division title at the start of the section. The woodcut initial H has been joined to the following word, which is printed in small capitals. The page ends mid-word ("vi-"); the continuation "sione" is given as the catchword.
